protocol: webmcp-draft — W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group incubation (2026)

security_boundary.quarantine: all tool inputs inspected before execution (WebMCP-Phalanx style)
security_boundary.human_in_the_loop: REQUIRED for REVERSIBLE and CONSEQUENTIAL tools
security_boundary.approval: DB-backed checkpoints (agent_checkpoints) + one-time HMAC-signed tokens, 5-minute TTL. The execute leg additionally requires the human's own login session (Google) — the token alone is not enough, and each checkpoint is consumed exactly once
security_boundary.rate_limit: consequential tools: 12 req/min per client (per-process; not a hard cap on serverless)
security_boundary.provenance: every response carries a provenance trail
security_boundary.audit: every tool call is recorded in Postgres agent_audit (/api/agent/audit, 90-day retention)
security_boundary.orders: approved orders persisted to Postgres orders + agent_orders
security_boundary.stock: stock/price are read live from Postgres; static snapshots are fallback only

tools.name: searchShoes
tools.description: Search the KINESIS catalog by keyword (name, series, category, material) with optional category filter.

tools.name: getShoe
tools.description: Get the full structured record for one product (specs, materials, edition, status).

tools.name: compareShoes
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 4 products across price, materials, status and category.

tools.name: checkStock
tools.description: Live availability per EU size for a product, including hot/out-of-stock flags.

tools.name: getProvenance
tools.description: Digital passport chain for a product (craft log, biometric mint, atelier verification, vault seal).

tools.name: addToCart
tools.description: Add a product to the visitor's cart. Reversible, but requires explicit human approval.

tools.name: createOrder
tools.description: Place a paid order. CONSEQUENTIAL action — blocked until a human approves the checkpoint.
